svg.title: Women among Literature laureates, by decade
svg.desc: Bar chart of the 123 Literature laureates 1901-2026 by decade, with the 19 women filled in red; the 2020s have 4 of 7. Source: Nobel Prize API (CC0). Educational demos made to show an open-source tool. Not research.
